# BrewTested — AI Source Index

BrewTested is an independent coffee and kitchen gear research site.
We publish buying guides based on owner feedback, spec analysis, and community data.
All guides are research-based; we disclose when products are not physically tested.

## What We Cover

Coffee makers, espresso machines, burr grinders, French presses, pour-over brewers,
milk frothers, coffee accessories, and kitchen gear. Focus on home and prosumer tier.

## Key Resources

- /espresso/ — Home espresso setup decision engine (machine + grinder routing)
- /coffee/ — Drip and filter coffee hub
- /kitchen/ — Kitchen gear overview

## Update Policy

Guides are reviewed when: product is discontinued, price changes materially,
a successor model launches, or owner feedback patterns shift significantly.
Each money page shows "Last reviewed" date.

## Affiliate Disclosure

BrewTested participates in Amazon Associates and other affiliate programs.
Commission rates do not influence recommendations. Independent research only.
No paid placements. No sponsored content without disclosure.
